ProjectDetail.title: Project details
ProjectDetail.subtitle: Comments, details, and photos will be added in upcoming phases.
ProjectDetail.author: Author
ProjectDetail.aboutDescription: This project was created as part of the JDU (Japan Digital University) student showcase, where students present their best work across design, development, and technology. Each project reflects the student's creative vision, technical skills, and dedication to building real-world digital products. From initial concept and wireframing through to final implementation, every detail was carefully considered to deliver a polished, professional result. The showcase serves as a platform for students to demonstrate their abilities, receive feedback from the community, and connect with potential collaborators and employers.
